gorseller.istem: Wide cinematic panoramic illustration of a traditional Anatolian village courtyard at golden hour, warm glowing sunset light, low whitewashed stone walls, terracotta pots with geraniums, a grapevine overhead, an old wooden door with a lantern. On the far left: a European hedgehog walking on the stone pavement toward the viewer and a green toad beside a watering can. On the far right: a little owl perched on top of the stone wall looking at the viewer and a small pale house gecko on the whitewashed wall. The middle third of the image is calm and uncluttered: softly blurred warm wall and sky, open space. A barn swallow flying in the golden sky. Vibrant, cinematic, high contrast, inviting and magical.

Portrait of a cute but realistic European hedgehog face looking directly at the viewer, big bright dark eyes, wet black nose, spines glowing in warm rim light, a small green leaf on its spines, centered in the frame and filling most of the image, simple warm golden-orange background with soft circular bokeh. Bold, clear shapes readable at very small size, high contrast.
